system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Hello, I have been farming for years and faced many issues. Recently, I heard about this service. Closes a resolved grievance. For your information, my ticket_id is None, my closure_confirmation is dummy_closure_confirmation_5506.

function.name: kcc_close_grievance
function.description: Closes a resolved grievance. Grievance can ONLY be closed after resolution or user confirmation. Transitions grievance_status to 'closed'. Requires session_token. Does NOT reopen grievances. Fails if grievance is not in 'resolved' status or closed prematurely.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

closure_confirmation.description: Farmer's confirmation to close. Must be true.
